description: A woman in a dark cape and a tiara rides a white horse down a muddy avenue, leading a crowd of people. Behind her, women in long coats and wide hats walk among men in bowler hats, and blank banners rise above the crowd. In the background a domed white building, which looks like the Capitol, sits under a grey sky between bare winter trees. The clothing and hats look early twentieth century. The painting is loose and textured, filling the whole image edge to edge, with no visible lettering.
